description: One private native Combat stage with three bots applies a shared draft edit and exercises all four independent visibility settings. The creator stays in the Room, reads the native overview when allowed, and publishes an authored start as the creator cursor. The ordinary peer stays in the Room through Continue and shutdown.

FORGE\.REVISION\.PIN: arena=mod:arena_grid_playtest_draft sha256=[0-9a-f]{64}
NET\.GRID\.EDIT: granted client=1
GRID\.PLAYTEST: prepared room=[0-9]+ arena=mod:arena_grid_playtest_draft

processes.wait_for: NET: SVC_AUTH from server, our ID is 1

required_sequences.name: ordinary-peer-stays-through-normal-host-shutdown
patterns: NET: SVC_AUTH from server, our ID is 2
NET: SVC_ROOM_ASSIGN: assigned to room [0-9]+
SMOKE\.GRID\.DRAFT: role=ordinary client=2 room=[0-9]+ lobby=1
NET: disconnected from server: Server is shutting down \(1\)
SMOKE\.GRID\.DRAFT: role=ordinary disconnected room=[0-9]+
SMOKE: result=grid_draft_complete .*code=0
